name: math-modeling-agent-system
description: 学术研究与数学建模多智能体协同系统（通用学术 + 建模双轨）。通用学术能力：论文写作与修订、深度研究、文献综述、模拟同行评审、去 AI 化润色、数据分析与统计解释、出版级绘图、LaTeX 排版编译、PDF/Excel/图示交付；数学建模专项：9 阶段全链路、迭代引擎、模型库与调优、赛题拆解。30 个 Skill + 24 个 Agent + 6 个命令。写论文、改论文、审稿、综述、做图、排版、数据分析、建模竞赛均可调用。学术四技能（academic-paper / deep-research / academic-paper-reviewer / academic-pipeline）由 academic-research-skills 插件提供，本插件通过命令前缀与引用协作。遇到更专用的 skill（spreadsheets:xlsx、presentations:pptx、documents:docx）时按任务择优。

description_i18n.en: Academic research + math-modeling multi-agent system (30 skills / 24 agents / 6 commands). General academic: paper writing & revision, deep research, literature review, simulated peer review, de-AI polishing, data analysis, publication-grade figures, LaTeX, PDF/Excel deliverables. Plus math-modeling track (9-phase pipeline, iteration engine). Academic 4-skill suite is provided by the academic-research-skills plugin.
